overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on extractive summarization of novel chapters with extensive evaluation using both automatic metrics (ROUGE, METEOR) and human evaluation (pyramid analysis). No LLM judges were used. The main contribution is developing better alignment methods for creating gold-standard extractive summaries.
